name: product-ops
description: AI-native toolkit for Product Owners, Delivery Managers, and engineering leads. Multi-agent initiative breakdown, PRD generation, codebase research, cross-platform audit workflow, RAML spec lookup, Claude Code rules + hooks, interview/questionnaire/handoff primitives, a memory-scaffold workflow, and tested Jira operations engines (board consistency with gated fixes, declarative changesets, duplicate check, follow-ups registry) - all configurable per team.
